mapper.select: SELECT T.*, C.TESTNAME, B.METHODID, B.TESTID, D.METHODNAME FROM T_EMC_ITEM T LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD B ON T.TESTMETHODID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST C ON B.TESTID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD D ON B.METHODID = D.ID WHERE T.ID = #{id}

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, B.TESTID, B.METHODID, B.TESTCATEGORYID, F.TESTCATEGORYDESC, G.TESTNAME, H.METHODNAME, A.ID ITEMID, A.ITEMNAME, A.ITEMALIASNAME, A.LOWLIMIT, A.HIGHLIMIT FROM T_EMC_ITEM A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD B ON B.ID = A.TESTMETHODID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_CATEGORY F ON B.TESTCATEGORYID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST G ON B.TESTID = G.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD H ON B.METHODID = H.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
